title: Document retained Codex test hazards across other writable sessions
outcome: Overlap lookup and command-start comments describe both in-turn writers and a still-running retained Codex test of another writable session. EngramRunningCodexTest's limitation states that a lost end under a still-current runtime blocks later checks by other writable sessions in its captured worktree until a reported end or runtime exit/clear/replacement. Document the current conservative contract without adding a release mechanism.
acceptance: Lookup and command-start comments no longer describe other writers solely as sessions in a turn.

The retained-test lifetime/limitation comment explicitly describes cross-session overlap, runtime/root ownership, and existing release conditions without promising process termination or a new release.
